description_en: This operation retrieves the details of multiple resources in a batch
description_zh: 本接口用于批量获取资源详情
kebab_example: aliyun config describe-discovered-resource-batch --resource-ids r-wz998f311e210000,r-wz97f4a734780000 --resource-types ACS::ECS::Disk,ACS::ECS::Instance --regions cn-shanghai,cn-hongkong,cn-zhangjiakou,cn-hangzhou --api-version 2020-09-07 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeDiscoveredResourceBatch

parameters.help_en: The resource IDs. Separate multiple resource IDs with commas (`,`)
parameters.help_zh: 资源ID。多个ID之间使用半角逗号（`,`）分隔
parameters.name: resource_ids

parameters.help_en: The resource types. Separate multiple resource types with commas (`,`)
parameters.help_zh: 资源类型。多个类型之间使用半角逗号（`,`）分隔
parameters.name: resource_types

parameters.help_en: The regions where the resources reside. Separate multiple regions with commas (`,`)
parameters.help_zh: 资源所属地域。多个地域之间使用半角逗号（`,`）分隔
parameters.name: regions
